description: Rename one of your Apple Music library playlists, change its description, or make it public/private. Returns the previous values and verifies the change. Refused while Apple does not show your last change to the playlist yet (the update sends every field back, so it would undo it). Uses Apple's web-player API (unofficial; needs APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN).

isPublic.description: Show it on your Apple Music profile (true) or not (false).

name: apple_music_update_playlist
title: Rename an Apple Music playlist or change its description
